linear.$description:
Easing curve: linear.
Usage: constant speed: progress bars, loaders, color fades.
Accessibility: honor prefers-reduced-motion; avoid flashing more than 3 times per second (WCAG 2.3.1); looping animation over 5 seconds needs pause/stop (WCAG 2.2.2).
AI: string token easing/linear; output as the CSS value (e.g. linear), never hard-code.
